jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
 

 
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
 
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
 
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
 
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
 
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment 

 
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
 
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus
 
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
 
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!
 

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!
 

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
 

 
• Manually picking orders
 
• Packing and labelling products
 
• Processing shipping documents
 
• Working with handheld scanners 
 

You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
 

 
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
 
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
 
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
 
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
 
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
 
• You speak English fluently

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

• Setup & Preparation: Prepare and mount molds onto injection molding machines.
• Machine Configuration: Set up, adjust, and fine-tune processing parameters on production machinery.
• Process Optimization: Ensure a continuous, correct, and safe production process.
• Technical Troubleshooting: Provide technical support during malfunctions, quick changeovers, or process deviations.
• Operations & Monitoring: Start up and monitor production lines, load machinery, and perform quality checks on finished products.
• Documentation & Safety: Draft production and incident reports, verify production orders, inspect safety mechanisms, and consistently adhere to safety and environmental standards.

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience as a Mold Setter in the plastics/polymer industry.
• Practical experience with ARBURG and ENGEL machinery is required. (Experience with Stork machinery is a plus, though these are being phased out).
• Technical Professional Bachelor's degree.
• Willing and flexible to work in a 3-shift rotation.
• Precise worker with a strong sense of responsibility, able to work independently.
• a good basic knowledge of English; willing to learn Dutch
• Willingness to work in a continuous shift system (24/7 operations)

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

Our client specializes in sustainable insulation materials and provides customers with a complete insulation solution.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Blowerdoor Technician, you will be responsible for carrying out airtightness tests on a wide range of construction projects. This role combines technical fieldwork with customer interaction and technical advisory services. 

Your responsibilities: 

• Performing blower door tests at residential homes, apartment buildings, retail stores, and other construction projects. 
• Using specialized testing equipment to measure the airtightness of buildings and identify air leakage. 
• Interpreting test results and preparing clear, accurate technical reports. 
• Explaining the results to customers and providing technical advice on potential improvements to enhance a building's airtightness. 
• Working independently on-site while ensuring a high-quality, accurate and customer-focused execution of all measurements. 
• Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers and acting as their technical point of contact throughout the testing process. 

The ideal Junior Blowerdoor Technician: 

• A junior profile with a technical background, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Construction or another relevant technical field. 
• Previous experience with blower door testing is not required. Motivation and willingness to learn are far more important. 
• A strong interest in engineering, construction, and building technologies, combined with a proactive, independent, and responsible mindset. 
• Good communication skills in French, with added knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• A flexible attitude, including the willingness to start early, work occasional evenings, and weekends. 
• Based in the Brussels or Flemish Brabant region, with the willingness to travel to construction sites throughout Belgium.

FILOform, part of the CRH group, is an innovative solution-focused development and manufacturing company. They focus on smart solutions for connecting, sealing and protecting underground cable, fibre optics and utility networks.

For over 60 years FILOform has broadend their international and domestic network. With their HQ located in the UK and sites in The Netherlands and Germany, their global network is expanding every day. They currently export their products over 30 countries worldwide and provide worldwide support to a wide variety of industries, focusing on Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. 

In order to broaden and complete their sealing portfolio, FILOform has joined forces with Wallmax, resulting in additional innovative solutions for their clients and prospects.

To secure the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax portfolio, within sealing, protection and cable management solutions, we are currently recruiting a Technical Sales Engineer.

Jobomschrijving

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
• Reliable and valuable business partner assuring strong stakeholder management.
• Strong analytical skillset with the ability to effectively analyze market trends and customer needs.
• Experience in tender management is a plus.
• You are based in Belgium and are flexible to travel across the country to visit clients.
• Flexible to travel to The Netherlands and/or UK when required (limited).
• This role is a stand alone role that is mainly managed from a Home Office setting.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and French.

jobs.occupation: Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development
jobs.description:
Our client is an international, fast-growing organization operating in a highly dynamic and data-driven B2B environment. As part of a leading European group, the Belgian organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the structure and support of an international matrix organization. To support its continued growth and further strengthen its customer-facing operations, our client is looking for a Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the Belgian organization. You will be responsible for leading a team of 30-35 Inside Sales & Customer Advisors across multiple locations, ensuring operational excellence, commercial performance and an outstanding customer experience. 

Working closely with both the Belgian leadership team and international stakeholders, you will translate strategic objectives into clear deliverables driving accountability and ownership. 

• Build a high-performing organisation by developing talent, empowering Team Leads and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
• Establish clear performance frameworks, monitor business-critical KPIs and proactively steer the organisation towards ambitious commercial and operational objectives. 
• Continuously evaluate and optimise workflows, sales processes and customer interactions to improve efficiency, quality and overall business performance. 
• Leverage data, reporting and digital tools to identify trends, generate actionable insights and support informed decision-making. 
• Act as the driving force behind operational change, successfully embedding new initiatives, technologies and best practices across the organisation. 
• Build trusted relationships with key internal stakeholders, ensuring strong cross functional collaboration and alignment within an international matrix environment. 
• Champion a customer-centric mindset by balancing commercial ambition with service excellence and long-term customer value. 
• Play an active role within the Belgian Management Team, contributing to the company's strategic direction and supporting its continued growth. 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, providing a strong foundation for a commercial leadership role. 
• Proven track record managing larger inside sales, contact centre or customer service teams within a B2B environment preferably within an international and/or matrix driven organisation. 
• Extensive people management experience and know how to coach teams towards performance and accountability. 
• Strong analytical mindset combined with experience managing performance through KPIs, reporting and data analysis. 
• Demonstrated experience improving operational processes and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels. 
• Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment where adaptability and resilience are essential. 
• Affinity with digital transformation, AI tools and process automation is considered a plus. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English are required.

As an Air Import Agent, you play a crucial role in coordinating export processes and providing excellent customer service. Read on and discover what your future could look like in our dynamic team!

Jobomschrijving

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.

airline offices.
